test_isolation_fix.problem: Module-scoped fixtures in test_dlh_import.py and test_journey_enrichment.py did not use app fixture. Other tests patched models.DB_PATH to temp files that were deleted, causing 'no such table' errors.
test_isolation_fix.solution: Added module-scoped autouse _isolated_db fixtures that create temp databases, patch DB_PATH, call init_db(), and restore on teardown.

journey_mine_timeout.root_cause: 120s timeout too short for mining with 6 new sources + Qdrant/ArangoDB queries
journey_mine_timeout.fix: Increased timeout from 120s to 300s in test_journey_review.py:39

career_advisor_flaky.root_cause: Under full-suite GPU load, _call_llm_json() inference times out (120s). Returns None, agent returns error dict, route returns 400.
career_advisor_flaky.fix: Added retry logic to BaseCareerAgent._call_llm_json() — retries once after 2s on transient failure

cost_economics.bug: Queried nonexistent cost_records table; real table is model_calls. Early return 1 prevented iteration.
cost_economics.fix: Table discovery via sqlite_master, iterates all rows

personaforge_inflation.bug: 8251 of 8438 records were g4_daily_runs CI artifacts
personaforge_inflation.fix: Excluded g4_daily_runs and live_validation_runs from os.walk
